name: Lap xuong tuoi
summary: A fresh sausage from the old Long An half, named with rượu đế Gò Đen and mắm còng Cần Giuộc among its specialties. It is not Tung Lò Mò, the fermented Cham beef sausage.
origin: The old Long An half of Tây Ninh, joined to the province by Resolution 202/2025/QH15.
howToEat: Look for it with the other old Long An specialties.
seoDescription: Lạp xưởng tươi, a fresh sausage of the old Long An half.
